_comment: Datasets the BBMP connector collects. Download URLs are never listed here: they are discovered from the dataset page on every run because they can change. 'column_overrides' maps a canonical field to an exact header when a file's header is not recognised (see app/bbmp_schema.py COLUMN_SYNONYMS). Edit this file or point BBMP_SOURCES_FILE at another one.

site_pages.note: Official site: scanned for links to CSV / Excel files. Not available to the developers when this was written, so what it offers is unknown.

crawl_sources.name: GBA / BBMP official website
crawl_sources.note: React app (checked 12 Nov 2026): the static HTML has no links; notices, tenders and PDF links are in /static/js/main.*.js, which the crawler reads. Playwright (BBMP_USE_PLAYWRIGHT=1) is the fallback. On 12 Nov 2026 the bundle listed 89 PDFs, 77 of them land-use maps (listed, not downloaded: skip_download_patterns).

crawl_sources.name: BBMP legacy site
crawl_sources.note: Old BBMP site; kept in case it still serves tender and work lists.

crawl_sources.name: OpenCity BBMP datasets
crawl_sources.note: Finds BBMP datasets that are not yet in the 'datasets' list above and lists their files.

ifms.note: BBMP IFMS 'Works Bill Public View'. Public search, no login or CAPTCHA. On 12-13 Nov 2026 its data service (vss00CvStatusData.php) answered HTTP 500 with an empty body to every request, including the page's own requests, so no data could be read.
